channel.title: Easter Daily Guide Podcast
channel.description:
Experience a full 50-day audio journey through the Easter Season. Each episode is synced to the exact day of Easter and plays automatically on the Easter Guide website. Follow along daily as we walk through the joy, renewal, and hope of the Resurrection one reflection at a time.

This podcast is designed for anyone seeking:

  • Daily Easter reflections
  • Christian devotionals
  • Easter Season prayers
  • Biblical meditations for the 50 days of Easter
  • A guided spiritual journey from Easter to Pentecost

Listen to the correct days episode and follow the full journey at:
https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/

Whether you are deepening your faith, building a daily prayer rhythm, or exploring the meaning of Easter in a fresh way, this podcast guides you through the entire season with clarity and peace.
channel.author: Eric Kouassi
channel.summary: A daily 50‑day Easter devotional with reflections synced to the live schedule at https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/. Listen each day for Scripture‑based guidance, prayer, and Easter Season inspiration.

funding.text: Support the Show by Buying Me a Coffee

episodes.title: Easter Day 1 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Mary Magdalene discovers the empty tomb at dawn, revealing the first light of resurrection joy. Today we begin a 50‑day journey through the Easter season, reflecting on the hope Christ’s rising brings into our lives. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: The Empty Tomb and the Dawn of New Hope
episodes.summary: A brief reflection on John 20:1 and the joy of the Resurrection as we begin Day 1 of 50 in the Easter journey.

episodes.title: Easter Day 2 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: The angels proclaim the heart of the Gospel: “He is not here; He has risen.” Let this truth renew your spirit today as we continue our 50‑day Easter journey. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: He Is Not Here — He Is Risen
episodes.summary: A brief reflection on Luke 24:5‑6, celebrating the living Christ and inviting gratitude for the gift of eternal life.

episodes.title: Easter Day 3 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: The women leave the empty tomb “afraid yet filled with joy,” running to share the good news. Today we reflect on how Christ’s resurrection joy moves us outward to encourage others. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Joy That Cannot Be Contained
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 28:8, inviting you to carry resurrection joy into someone else’s life through hope, love, and simple connection.

episodes.title: Easter Day 4 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Mary weeps outside the tomb, yet even in her sorrow, God is already at work. Today we reflect on the nearness of Jesus in our struggles and the quiet joy His presence brings. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: A reflection on John 20:11‑12, reminding us that even in moments of grief, Christ draws near with comfort, light, and resurrection joy.

episodes.title: Easter Day 5 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Jesus speaks Mary’s name, and everything changes. Today we reflect on the tender truth that Christ knows us personally and calls each of us by name. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Called by Name
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 20:16, inviting you to rest in the personal love of Jesus, who knows you, calls you, and draws you close.

episodes.title: Easter Day 6 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: The risen Jesus meets the women on the road, and their immediate response is worship. Today we pause to adore Christ for His victory over death and His living presence with us. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Worship at His Feet
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 28:9, inviting you into simple, heartfelt worship as you celebrate the risen Christ.

episodes.title: Easter Day 7 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Peter runs to the tomb and leaves in awe, wondering what God has done. Today we pause with that same sense of holy wonder, letting the mystery of the resurrection deepen our faith. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Wonder at the Empty Tomb
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:12, inviting you to marvel at the resurrection and notice signs of new life as reminders of Christ’s victory.

episodes.title: Easter Day 8 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Mary becomes the first witness of the resurrection, joyfully declaring, “I have seen the Lord!” Today we reflect on sharing that same good news with boldness and joy. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.subtitle: I Have Seen the Lord
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 20:18, encouraging you to proclaim Christ’s victory and share the joy of Easter with others.

episodes.title: Easter Day 9 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: Christ is the “firstfruits” of resurrection — the promise that new life is not only His but ours as well. Today we rejoice in the hope of eternal life secured through His rising. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: The Firstfruits of New Life
episodes.summary: A reflection on 1 Corinthians 15:20, celebrating Christ’s resurrection as the guarantee of our own and inviting you to rest in the hope of eternal life.

episodes.title: Easter Day 10 of 50 — Resurrection Joy
episodes.description: “Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.” Today we reflect on how the resurrection turns sorrow into joy and brings light into every dark place. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Joy Comes in the Morning
episodes.summary: A reflection on Psalm 30:5, celebrating the promise that Christ’s resurrection brings joy after sorrow and light after darkness.

episodes.title: Easter Day 11 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: Christ’s resurrection opens the way for us to live a new life. Today we reflect on what it means to walk in that newness with purpose, gratitude, and hope. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Raised to Walk in Newness
episodes.summary: A reflection on Romans 6:4, celebrating the new life we receive through Christ’s resurrection and inviting you to nurture that life with intentional growth.

episodes.title: Easter Day 12 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: In Christ, the old is gone and the new has come. Today we reflect on the transforming power of being made new in Him and the invitation to release what no longer belongs to us. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: The New Creation Has Come
episodes.summary: A reflection on 2 Corinthians 5:17, encouraging you to embrace the new life Christ offers and let go of what no longer serves your walk with Him.

episodes.title: Easter Day 13 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: Because we have been raised with Christ, our hearts are called upward. Today we reflect on fixing our focus on the things above and living from the new life He gives. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Set Your Heart on Things Above
episodes.summary: A reflection on Colossians 3:1, inviting you to lift your heart toward Christ and anchor your life in His eternal promises.

episodes.title: Easter Day 14 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: New life in Christ means becoming more like Him. Today we reflect on putting on the new self — a life shaped by righteousness, holiness, and love. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Put On the New Self
episodes.summary: A reflection on Ephesians 4:22‑24, inviting you to embrace the new self Christ forms in you and to express His love through simple acts of kindness.

episodes.title: Easter Day 15 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: God is always at work, bringing newness into our lives. Today we reflect on His invitation to perceive the new things He is doing and to welcome His transforming work with open hands. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: God Is Doing a New Thing
episodes.summary: A reflection on Isaiah 43:19, encouraging you to notice and embrace the new things God is bringing forth in your life — new growth, new perspective, new hope.

episodes.title: Easter Day 16 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: New life in Christ means more than a fresh start — it means Christ Himself living in us. Today we reflect on surrender, presence, and allowing His life to shape our own. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Christ Lives in Me
episodes.summary: A reflection on Galatians 2:20, inviting you into deeper surrender as you welcome Christ’s life, love, and guidance within you.

episodes.title: Easter Day 17 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: Through Christ’s resurrection, we are given new birth into a living hope — a hope that breathes, sustains, and renews us daily. Today we rejoice in God’s mercy and the new life He offers. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Born Into a Living Hope
episodes.summary: A reflection on 1 Peter 1:3, celebrating the mercy of God who gives us new birth and fills our lives with living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: Easter Day 18 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: Christ’s resurrection is not just a past event — it is the beginning of God’s renewal of everything. Today we reflect on His promise to make all things new and invite that renewal into our own hearts and lives. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.subtitle: Behold, I Am Making All Things New
episodes.summary: A reflection on Revelation 21:5, reminding you that God is actively renewing all things — including you — and inviting you to imagine what His “new” looks like in your spiritual journey.

episodes.title: Easter Day 19 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: New life is not something we create — it is something the Holy Spirit works within us. Today we reflect on the Spirit’s renewing power and invite His life‑giving presence to refresh our hearts. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Renewed by the Spirit
episodes.summary: A reflection on Titus 3:5, celebrating the Holy Spirit’s work of rebirth and renewal and encouraging you to welcome His refreshing presence into your daily life.

episodes.title: Easter Day 20 of 50 — New Life
episodes.description: God’s mercies meet us fresh each morning. Today we pause to receive His compassion, His steady love, and the renewal He offers at the start of every new day. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: New Mercies Every Morning
episodes.summary: A reflection on Lamentations 3:22‑23, inviting you to begin the day with gratitude for God’s unfailing love and the new mercies He pours out over your life.

episodes.title: Easter Day 21 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: On the road to Emmaus, Jesus comes alongside two disciples in their confusion and sorrow. Today we reflect on the quiet, faithful ways He walks with us — even when we don’t recognize Him at first. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: He Walks With Us
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:13‑15, inviting you to notice Christ’s presence on your own journey and to walk with Him in trust, openness, and expectation.

episodes.title: Easter Day 22 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: At the table in Emmaus, Jesus reveals Himself in the breaking of bread. Today we reflect on how Christ still makes Himself known in the Eucharist and in the simple meals we share. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Their Eyes Were Opened
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:30‑31, inviting you to recognize Jesus in the breaking of bread and in the ordinary moments where He reveals His presence.

episodes.title: Easter Day 23 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Behind locked doors, Jesus appears to His fearful disciples and speaks peace. Today we reflect on the Risen Lord who enters our fears and breathes calm into our hearts. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Peace Be With You
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 20:19, inviting you to let Christ’s peace settle your fears and fill your heart with His presence.

episodes.title: Easter Day 24 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Jesus meets Thomas in his doubts, offering His wounds as proof of His love. Today we reflect on the gentle way Christ meets us in our questions and uncertainties. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Do Not Doubt, But Believe
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 20:27, inviting you to bring your doubts to Jesus and let His love meet you where you are.

episodes.title: Easter Day 25 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: At dawn on the shore, Jesus stands unrecognized by His disciples. Today we reflect on the quiet, hidden ways Christ appears in our ordinary moments. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: He Stood on the Shore
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 21:4, inviting you to notice the subtle ways Jesus is present in your daily life.

episodes.title: Easter Day 26 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Jesus invites His disciples to breakfast, providing for them with simple, tender care. Today we reflect on the Lord who nourishes us in body and soul. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Come and Have Breakfast
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 21:12, inviting you to trust in Christ’s daily provision and His loving care for your needs.

episodes.title: Easter Day 27 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Jesus appears among His disciples and speaks peace into their gathering. Today we reflect on inviting Christ into our conversations, relationships, and daily interactions. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Jesus Stood Among Them
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:36, inviting you to welcome Christ’s peace into your relationships and moments of connection.

episodes.title: Easter Day 28 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Jesus blesses those who believe without seeing. Today we reflect on the gift of faith and the blessing Christ speaks over all who trust Him. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Blessed Are Those Who Believe
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 20:29, inviting you to rest in the blessing Christ gives to all who believe without seeing.

episodes.title: Easter Day 29 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: On the shore, Jesus restores Peter with a simple but profound question: “Do you love Me?” Today we reflect on Christ’s restoring love and His call to deeper devotion. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Do You Love Me?
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 21:15, inviting you to let Jesus restore your heart and draw you into deeper love for Him.

episodes.title: Easter Day 30 of 50 — Christ’s Appearances
episodes.description: Jesus commissions His disciples to go into the world, promising His presence always. Today we reflect on living out His mission with courage and trust. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: I Am With You Always
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 28:19‑20, inviting you to trust Christ’s presence as you share His love with the world.

episodes.title: Easter Day 31 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: For forty days after His resurrection, Jesus appeared to His disciples, preparing them for His Ascension. Today we reflect on how Christ prepares our hearts for His mission. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Preparing Their Hearts
episodes.summary: A reflection on Acts 1:3, inviting you to notice how Jesus prepares you for the work He entrusts to you.

episodes.title: Easter Day 32 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Jesus lifts His hands and blesses His disciples as He ascends. Today we reflect on receiving His blessing and letting it shape our lives. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: He Lifted His Hands
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:50, inviting you to receive Christ’s blessing and let it guide your purpose.

episodes.title: Easter Day 33 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Before ascending, Jesus promises the Holy Spirit and commissions His disciples as witnesses. Today we reflect on the Spirit’s power at work in us. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: You Will Receive Power
episodes.summary: A reflection on Acts 1:8, inviting you to trust the Holy Spirit to empower your witness.

episodes.title: Easter Day 34 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Christ is taken up before the disciples’ eyes, returning to the Father in glory. Today we reflect on His heavenly reign and our call to look to Him. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Taken Up Before Their Eyes
episodes.summary: A reflection on Acts 1:9, inviting you to lift your gaze to Christ, ascended in glory.

episodes.title: Easter Day 35 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Jesus ascends and sits at the right hand of God, interceding for us. Today we reflect on His authority and His care for our lives. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Seated at the Right Hand
episodes.summary: A reflection on Mark 16:19, inviting you to trust Christ’s intercession and His reign in heaven.

episodes.title: Easter Day 36 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Christ is exalted above every rule and authority. Today we reflect on surrendering every part of our lives to His lordship. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Far Above All Rule
episodes.summary: A reflection on Ephesians 1:20‑21, inviting you to trust Christ’s authority over all things.

episodes.title: Easter Day 37 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: Jesus, our great high priest, has ascended into heaven. Today we reflect on holding firmly to our faith in Him. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Our Great High Priest
episodes.summary: A reflection on Hebrews 4:14, inviting you to cling to your faith in the ascended Christ.

episodes.title: Easter Day 38 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: The angels remind the disciples that Jesus will return just as He ascended. Today we reflect on living with hope and readiness for His coming. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: He Will Come Again
episodes.summary: A reflection on Acts 1:11, inviting you to live with hope in Christ’s promised return.

episodes.title: Easter Day 39 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: The Ascension calls us to set our minds on things above. Today we reflect on fixing our thoughts on Christ and His kingdom. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Set Your Mind Above
episodes.summary: A reflection on Colossians 3:2, inviting you to focus your heart and mind on Christ’s heavenly reign.

episodes.title: Easter Day 40 of 50 — Ascension
episodes.description: After witnessing the Ascension, the disciples return to Jerusalem with great joy. Today we reflect on worshiping Christ with the same joy and devotion. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: They Returned with Joy
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 24:52‑53, inviting you to praise Christ with joy for His Ascension and reign.

episodes.title: Easter Day 41 of 50 — Holy Spirit
episodes.description: Jesus promises the Holy Spirit, the Advocate who will be with us forever. Today we reflect on welcoming the Spirit as we approach Pentecost. Follow along daily: https://easterguide.dailyaudio.cf/
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: The Spirit of Truth
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 14:16‑17, inviting you to welcome the Holy Spirit’s guidance and presence.
